what: The xanadu route (settlements/xanadu/STACK-PLAN.md section 8): four stops at the stack's three hours, for tools/route_harness.py (web) and godot/tests/perf/route_harness.gd, both on claude/vertical-stack. Data only before Stage 8; XP1 adds the two stop kinds below to the harnesses (each a few lines beside openworld_hamlet and av_preset), records the baselines on the Arc, the RTX and in Godot, and fills each Godot stop's pose from the place's export. Checked by settlements/xanadu/tests/test-xs1-stack.js.

kinds.page_view: the page's own named view (V[name] in its views fragment): [ex, ey, ez, tx, ty, tz] in the page's frame, resolved at run time from the buildings' blocks, so a re-seat or a re-bake moves the stop with the town
kinds.page_block: a pose in one kit block's frame, as the page's views take it (91z-views.js `at(B, c, t)`): eye and target are the block's x, y, z plus the offsets; the block is found by key in CIT_G.blocks
kinds.openworld_site: a pose by a site of the region's data/region.json, found by id (ids survive the Stage 8 re-bake; positions do not): eye = site + (dx, dz) at agl metres over the ground, target = site + (tx, tz) at ty metres over the ground (0 for a water target: the water's surface)
kinds.openworld_site_shore: a pose on a site's shore: from the site along a line, toward another site (`toward`, by id) or on a bearing (`bearing`, degrees: 0 north (-z), 90 east (+x), 180 south (+z)); eye on the first land cell along it with water within 20 m, agl metres over the ground; target `look` metres further along the same line at the water's surface plus ty

stops.label: Phish-Mārkiṭ's quay, east across the lake past Wesṭ-Āil to the caldera wall

fallback.until: Phish-Mārkiṭ's town is built (the lake round's west towns, BUILD-PLAN.md)
Gārḍan's town and orchards are built

stops.label: Through the Vizier's palace door into its hall (the interiors track's stop)
stops.note: the eye in the pool garden 6.5 m before the garden face's middle arch (kits/xanadu/src/78n-xa-citadel.js, buildXaCitVizier: the iwan at block z 10.6), looking through it into the loggia to its back wall (block z 2), where the leaf doors to the petitions hall and the chancery are. `door` is that arch's portal in XS2's room graph (claude/citadel-room-graph, settlements/xanadu/citadel/rooms/89yr-xa-citadel-rooms.js: cit.vizier.garden, outdoor, to cit.vizier.loggia, open, 6 m wide, at citadel -424, -135 = block 0, 10)
